caseData.headline: Likely: the same collateral is pledged to more than one lender

findings.plain: the same collateral is pledged to more than one lender
bad loans are being reported as good ones
the reported financial statements don't fit the evidence

signals.explanation: 32 vehicles (matched by VIN) are pledged in two Wells Fargo facilities at once
Servicer-system pull: 4 of 60 sampled 'eligible' loans are actually 60+ days late or no longer active
Loans reported current but with no payment for two months were pulled from the servicer system: 4 of 30 are actually 60+ days late or no longer active
Loans the tape shows going from 30-59 days late to current were pulled from the servicer system: 3 of 10 are actually 60+ days late or no longer active
Setpoint PledgeCheck: collateral appears in more than one active facility
20.2% of loans reported current had no payment arrive (151 of 746)

44 of the 44 loans that also sit in the public trust paid nothing into the Wells Fargo collection account in the last three months, though they are still on the tape: their payments are going somewhere else

44 loans pledged to Wells Fargo match loans that the borrower's own public securitization (SYN-ABS-B0103) reports to investors, on every field allowing for small reporting differences, two months running. The SEC data has no VIN: ask for the VINs and titles to settle it
Reported revenue is running 40% above what verified customer cash supports (2 quarters in a row)
Setpoint PledgeCheck: actual collections don't match what the borrower reported
Only 0 of 47 loans reported 30-59 days late were 60+ late a month later (0%). In 28 real public auto-loan pools the lowest rate is 14%: late loans here seem to vanish instead of getting later
Covenant metric landed within 5% above the threshold two quarters running

explanations: payments from Silverline Property Partners LLC are from a disclosed related party

steps.title: Pause new advances against the affected collateral
steps.draft:
INTERNAL ACTION MEMO — Pause new advances against the affected collateral
Case: B0103 · Finding: the same collateral is pledged to more than one lender (high confidence)
Action: Place a hold on further advances against the collateral named in the evidence until uniqueness is confirmed.
Based on:
  - 32 vehicles (matched by VIN) are pledged in two Wells Fargo facilities at once [ref S1-B0103-DUPLICATE_ASSET-afd09cf6]
  - Setpoint PledgeCheck: collateral appears in more than one active facility [ref S1-B0103-PLEDGECHECK_UNIQUENESS_FAIL-552dcb71]
  - 44 of the 44 loans that also sit in the public trust paid nothing into the Wells Fargo collection account in the last three months, though they are still on the tape: their payments are going somewhere else [ref S1-B0103-POOL_LOANS_PAID_ELSEWHERE-e3280d9b]
  - 44 loans pledged to Wells Fargo match loans that the borrower's own public securitization (SYN-ABS-B0103) reports to investors, on every field allowing for small reporting differences, two months running. The SEC data has no VIN: ask for the VINs and titles to settle it [ref S1-B0103-PUBLIC_POOL_OVERLAP-85d25e25]

Due: 2026-10-16 · Requires approval before it is carried out.
